title: The National Judicial Policy Making Committee Amendment Act 2014

sections.shortTitle: The National Judicial Policy Making Committee Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PART I
The National Judicial (Policy Making) Committee (Amendment) Act 2014
PART I
Acts, Ordinances, President s Orders and Regulations
SENATE SECRETARIAT
Islamabad, the 10 June, 2014
No. F. 9(7)/2014-Legis.- The following Act
of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on 6th June, 2014, is hereby publish for general information:-
Act No. III OF 2014
An
Act further to amend the National Judicial (Policy Making) Committee Ordinance.
2002
WHEREAS it is expedient Further
to amend the National Judicial (Policy Making) Committee Ordinance, 2002 (LXXI
of 2002), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.- (1) This Act may be called the
National Judicial (Policy Making) Committee (Amendment) Act, 2014.
(2) it shall come into force at
once.
